# Summary
Part of the batch of 13 blog topic ideas drafted from the 49-post review on June 24-25 and saved to `blog-drafts\` (per the handoff: drafted, not published). Source: `blog-drafts\how-long-does-trenchless-sewer-repair-take.md`. Each draft carries a focus keyphrase, SEO title, meta, slug, internal link list, image alt ideas and external sources.

# Key facts
- **Focus keyphrase:** how long does trenchless sewer repair take.
- **Status:** draft only; not in the July 21 live blog inventory, and no later publish record in this folder.
- The meta says most Arizona jobs finish in one day. That conflicts with the approved wording "most jobs take a couple of days". Sep 18 research found 0 searches.
